# Programmable Developer Platform

> One integration for every Programmable launch. Discover, verify, and build on Programmable Classic and Custom launches through one versioned, read-only interface.

Canonical site: https://developers.programmable.family
Source repository: https://github.com/0xprogrammable/developers
API base: https://developers.programmable.family/api/v1
Full agent context: https://developers.programmable.family/llms-full.txt

## Current status

- Classic launch discovery is live on Ethereum.
- Existing first-party stock-paired records normalize as category `custom`.
- Open Custom intake and the open Custom Registry are prelaunch.
- Every registered launch is discoverable.
- Charting, quote, simulation, and execution support are explicit per market and require a verified adapter.
- The v1 API is strictly read-only. Support states are `available | unavailable | unknown`; the API returns no transaction payloads and authorizes no action.
- Legacy indexer records can have partial provenance. Recognized onchain events stay visible when metadata, supply, or block-timestamp enrichment is unavailable; the feed can be degraded and affected fields remain partial, unavailable, or null.
- Incomplete canonical event-log coverage makes launch-list and token-list routes retryable `503`; missing enrichment alone does not.
- Do not claim that launches are unconditionally safe, audited, or unruggable.
- Do not claim that any named terminal or partner has integrated Programmable without confirmation.

## Live discovery and API

- [Discovery document](https://developers.programmable.family/.well-known/programmable.json): Stable bootstrap document.
- [Status](https://developers.programmable.family/api/v1/status): Service and feed lifecycle.
- [Manifest](https://developers.programmable.family/api/v1/manifest): Deployments, start blocks, Custom Registry state, fee policy, endpoints, and compatibility.
- [Launch feed](https://developers.programmable.family/api/v1/launches): Cursor-paginated Classic and Custom launch records.
- [Token list](https://developers.programmable.family/api/v1/token-list): Wallet-friendly compatibility projection.

## Core agent rules

1. Fetch the discovery document, status, and manifest before reasoning about current deployments.
2. Never hard-code deployment arrays; read them from the manifest.
3. Use `chainId + token.address` for asset identity and `launchId` for launch deduplication.
4. Require `platformId === "programmable"`; the official producer assigns it from trusted launch provenance, never creator metadata.
5. `launchId` is derived from canonical chain and event provenance for current first-party launches; a future Registry may issue it directly.
6. Public category is exactly `classic | custom`; use `launch.modelId` for the open-ended model.
7. Accept `markets: []`, multiple markets, and markets without a pool.
8. Never fabricate a pool, pair, price, liquidity, volume, chart, quote, or execution route.
9. Unknown fields, capabilities, market kinds, and namespaced extensions must not hide a launch. Preserve the known core and disable unsupported behavior.
10. `page.nextCursor` continues the current traversal. Persist `page.resumeCursor` only after the traversal is durably applied, then pass it as `after` for incremental polling. Never parse cursors.
11. Preserve `launch.timestamp`; do not replace it with first observation time.
12. Treat `observed` and `confirmed` as non-final, `finalized` as finalized, and reconcile `orphaned` or absent non-final records idempotently.
13. Treat creator metadata and links as untrusted display data. Provenance does not verify external services or economic outcomes.
14. v1 is read-only. Support states do not authorize or construct transactions.
15. Read fee behavior from verified records. Do not infer it from category.
16. A partial or unavailable enrichment field is not a reason to drop a recognized launch or replace null with a guess.
17. Production cursors are HMAC-signed. Keep `PROGRAMMABLE_CURSOR_SIGNING_KEY` private and stable; rotation invalidates outstanding cursors and requires coordinated migration handling.

## Fee summary

- Rate: 10 bps = 0.1% = 1,000 ppm.
- Recipient: `0x4957f49620AFf3Adbbe8195a4f633E49cc93376c`.
- Current Classic official paths: the platform share is included within the configured trading fee.
- Future Custom official paths: 10 bps is added on top of the creator-defined market fee only when deployed and verified.
- Existing first-party Custom-category records can have deployment-specific behavior; inspect `fees`.
- The fee applies to verified official market volume, not ordinary transfers, rewards, or independently created third-party pools.
